name: KRETAM
recent: Kretam 近期出现一系列董事会与委员会人事变动，包括执行主席 Yin Kong Fung 于 2026 年 11 月 1 日辞任，Chiong Yong Foo 加入董事会，Chiong 家族成员亦持续申报股权变动。公司同时按月公布鲜果串产量，最新一期为 2026 年 11 月 11 日。最新财报（2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度）显示营收环比增长 42.9%，但录得净亏损 970.8 万令吉。
notable: 执行主席 Yin Kong Fung 于 2026 年 11 月 1 日辞任，Chiong Yong Foo 加入董事会。
多名董事在风险、薪酬、提名及审计委员会中出现职务变动。
Chiong 家族成员（Chiong Yong Foo、Chiong Hang Leong）于 10 月多次申报股权变动。
risks: 最新季度录得净亏损 970.8 万令吉，净利率为 -3.7%。
董事会及多个委员会出现密集人事变动。
大股东 Chiong Yong Foo 与 Chiong Hang Leong 在 10 月多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 2.60137 亿令吉，环比增长 42.9%，同比增长 38.8%；净亏损 970.8 万令吉，净利率 -3.7%，上一季度净利率为 2.8%，净利润环比下降 291.5%。

recent_en: Kretam has seen a series of board and committee changes, including the resignation of Executive Chairman Yin Kong Fung effective 1 November 2026, the appointment of Chiong Yong Foo to the board, and continued shareholding disclosures by members of the Chiong family. The company also publishes monthly fresh fruit bunch production figures, with the latest on 11 November 2026. The latest quarterly report (quarter ended 30 June 2026) showed revenue up 42.9% qoq but a net loss of MYR 9.708 million.
notable_en: Executive Chairman Yin Kong Fung resigned effective 1 November 2026, and Chiong Yong Foo joined the board.
Several directors had changes in their roles on the risk, remuneration, nomination and audit committees.
Chiong family members (Chiong Yong Foo, Chiong Hang Leong) filed multiple shareholding changes in October.
risks_en: The latest quarter recorded a net loss of MYR 9.708 million, with a net margin of -3.7%.
There were密集 board and committee changes.
Substantial shareholders Chiong Yong Foo and Chiong Hang Leong filed multiple shareholding changes in October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 260.137 million, up 42.9% qoq and 38.8% yoy; net loss was MYR 9.708 million with a net margin of -3.7%, compared with a net margin of 2.8% in the previous quarter, and net income fell 291.5% qoq.
